histogram.summary: Collected on Windows when tbs.dll fails to load during TPM certification. Records the HRESULT from loading the library.

histogram.name: Crypto.TPMOperation.Win.SrkRecovery.Result
histogram.summary: Recorded on Windows when creating an attestation key via TPM2_Create fails because the parent Storage Root Key handle does not exist, which happens when the Platform Crypto Provider was unable to persist it. Records the outcome of recreating the SRK as a transient object with TPM2_CreatePrimary and retrying TPM2_Create under that object. Recorded exactly once per recovery attempt, so the total count is the number of affected key creations.

histogram.name: Crypto.TPMOperation.Win.Tpm{Command}Parse.Result

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskDuration{Priority}
histogram.summary:
Records the time that passed between starting a TPM operation on an unexportable_keys::UnexportableKeyService and completing the operation (either successfully or not).
This time includes both the time spent waiting in a task queue and the execution time. These sub-intervals are covered by Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskQueueWaitDuration and Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskRunDuration histograms correspondingly.
Includes operations that were scheduled with {Priority}.
Recorded right after a TPM operation completes.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskQueueWaitDuration{Priority}
histogram.summary:
Records the time spent waiting in a task queue for the subset of TPM operations that are asynchronously scheduled through unexportable_keys::UnexportableKeyService.
This duration is a sub-interval of Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskDuration.
Includes operations that were scheduled with {Priority}.
Recorded right before a TPM operation is sent to the background thread for execution.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskResult{TaskOrigin}{TaskType}
histogram.summary:
Records the result of the subset of TPM operations that are scheduled asynchronously through unexportable_keys::UnexportableKeyService. In some error cases, the result might be returned synchronously.
Recorded right after a TPM operation completes. Recorded only for {TaskType} originating from {TaskOrigin}.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskRetries{TaskType}{Success}
histogram.summary:
Records the number retries it took to complete a TPM operation scheduled through unexportable_keys::UnexportableKeyService, only for operations that are completed with {Success}.
Recorded right after a TPM operation completes. Recorded only for {TaskType}.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskRunDuration{TaskType}
histogram.summary:
Records the time that passed between starting executing a TPM operation on a background thread and completing the operation (either successfully or not). Includes only a subset of TPM operations that are scheduled asynchronously through unexportable_keys::UnexportableKeyService.
This duration is a sub-interval of Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskDuration. Unlike Crypto.UnexportableKeys.BackgroundTaskDuration, this histogram is split by a task type instead of a task priority because the priority doesn't matter once a task starts executing. Only one task can be executed at the time due to TPM limitations.
Includes {TaskType}.
Recorded right after a TPM operation completes.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.GarbageCollection.{KeyDeletionClient}.{MetricName}
histogram.summary:
Records {MetricName} at the time of garbage collection triggered for {KeyDeletionClient}.
Typically, the unexportable keys garbage collection runs with some delay after a profile startup but it also might be triggered in response to UnexportableKeyService deletion events. For example, a garbage collection will run when a profile is deleted.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.SparePool.{KeyType}.GenerateError
histogram.summary: Recorded when a background task finishes generating a spare {KeyType} key to replenish the pool, regardless of success or failure. Records 'Success' (0, corresponding to kNoServiceErrorForMetrics in C++) or the specific ServiceError code on failure.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.SparePool.{KeyType}.PoolSize
histogram.summary: Recorded when an asynchronous {KeyType} key generation request is received, immediately before checking the pool for a hit or triggering replenishment. Records the total {KeyType} key pool size.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.SparePool.{KeyType}.ReplenishmentLatency
histogram.summary: Recorded when a background task successfully generates a spare {KeyType} key to replenish the pool. Records the duration (in milliseconds) of the background task from its launch until completion.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.SparePool.{KeyType}.RequestLatency
histogram.summary: Recorded when an asynchronous {KeyType} key generation request completes (its callback is executed), regardless of whether the spare pool feature is enabled or disabled. Records the duration (in milliseconds) from the initial request until callback execution, covering both instantaneous pool hits and slow fallback background generations.

histogram.name: Crypto.UnexportableKeys.SparePool.{KeyType}.RetrievalResult
histogram.summary: Recorded when a consumer requests a {KeyType} key asynchronously. Records the outcome (hit, various miss reasons, or hardware support failure) of attempting to retrieve a pre-generated spare {KeyType} key from the background pool.
